description: This file defines the RedirectResponse class, which extends the Response class, to produce HTTP redirect responses with a Location header and a status code (default 302). It includes functionality for handling URI inputs as either strings or UriInterface objects.

classes.name: RedirectResponse
classes.description: A class to generate HTTP redirect responses with specified Location header and status code.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the response with a redirect URI, status code, and headers. Validates the URI parameter and sets the Location header.
